reference_sql:
WITH week_views AS (
  -- one row per page_view event of 1 to 7 December 2025 (Dublin days): only the columns the counts need
  SELECT user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'page_location')[1].value.string_value AS page_location
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
), paths AS (
  -- one row per page_view: its path, without the host and any query string
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id, split_part(split_part(page_location, '?', 1), 'www.mailvora.example', 2) AS page
  FROM week_views
)
SELECT page, COUNT(*) AS page_views,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id || '-' || ga_session_id) AS sessions
FROM paths
GROUP BY page

WITH week_views AS (
  -- one row per page_view event of 1 to 7 December 2025 (Dublin days): only the columns the counts need
  SELECT user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'page_location')[1].value.string_value AS page_location
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
)
SELECT regexp_extract(page_location, '^https?://[^/]+([^?]*)', 1) AS page, COUNT(*) AS page_views,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND ga_session_id IS NOT NULL THEN user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(ga_session_id AS VARCHAR) END) AS sessions
FROM week_views
GROUP BY regexp_extract(page_location, '^https?://[^/]+([^?]*)', 1)
